query: Please implement a rate limiting website to control access frequency. The website should have functionalities for setting rate limiting rules, monitoring access frequency, and limiting access that exceeds the rate limit. Users should be able to set rate limiting rules, monitor access frequency, and limit access that exceeds the rate limit. The website should be able to record access logs, provide access statistics and analysis functions. Use lemon mist for the background and dark orange for components.
